subject: Take-home packet and reviewer coordination — Senior Inference Engineer (Morgan Taylor)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Taylor <morgan.taylor@example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Take-home packet and reviewer coordination — Senior Inference Engineer (Morgan Taylor)

Hi Morgan —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview for the Senior Inference Engineer role. As discussed on the call, attached is the take-home prompt: a short system-design + micro-benchmark exercise that should take ~6–10 hours total. A couple of important notes up front: 

- Deadline: 72 hours from now; preferred submission by 2026-10-14 09:00 PT. If you need a small accommodation, let me know and we can try to adjust.
- Deliverable: a single ZIP containing a short write-up (PDF or MD), a small benchmarking script (optional), and any diagrams. Put the primary write-up at README.md for easy reviewer consumption.
- Where to submit: reply to this thread with the ZIP or share a Drive link (please set view/comment permissions to redwood-internal reviewers).
- Reviewers: Laura, Dev, and Hannah will complete a structured review using the attached rubric; expect ~60–90 minutes of review per person. We’ll then run a 45-min debrief with the panel if the submission is accepted.

Attached: takehome_prompt_inference_v2.pdf (prompt + grading rubric overview). I’ve also dropped the materials in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cTakehomePrompt

Please confirm receipt and whether the timeline works for you. Looking forward to your submission.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments: takehome_prompt_inference_v2.pdf (5 pages, PDF)

From: Morgan Taylor <morgan.taylor@example.com>

Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Take-home packet and reviewer coordination — Senior Inference Engineer (Morgan Taylor)

Hi Jonas —

Thanks — received the prompt and Drive link. Quick question: I’m traveling this week and won’t have a solid block until the weekend. Would you consider a short extension to end-of-day Monday (2026-10-18) instead of the 72 hours? If that’s not possible I’ll do my best to meet the 72-hour window.

—Morgan
Morgan Taylor
(mobile: +1-415-555-0199)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Taylor <morgan.taylor@example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 10:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Take-home packet and reviewer coordination — Senior Inference Engineer (Morgan Taylor)

Hi Morgan —

Thanks for the heads up. We can offer a short, one-business-day accommodation: new due date 2026-10-15 23:59 PT. That keeps the hiring loop moving but gives you a little breathing room. If you absolutely need until 2026-10-18, tell me and I’ll escalate to the hiring manager — we’d prefer to avoid pushing the loop more than a few days.

Also, one logistical thing: please include an estimated wall-clock time spent and a short note on any assumptions (e.g., CPU vs GPU, dataset size) in your submission; that helps reviewers contextualize choices.

Confirm when you accept the new deadline and I’ll update the calendar for reviewer slots.

Regards,
Jonas

From: Morgan Taylor <morgan.taylor@example.com>

Subject: Re: Take-home packet and reviewer coordination — Senior Inference Engineer (Morgan Taylor)

Hi all —

Uploading my submission here as requested. Attached is morgan_taylor_takehome.zip and a short summary below. Please confirm you can access the files.

Summary: I implemented a lightweight batching simulator and a short write-up (~3 pages) showing tradeoffs for KV cache sizing and a 2x latency improvement using attention-sparse kernels for the benchmark scenario. Spent ~7.5 hours total.

Drive link (shared to redwood reviewers): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1q2w3eMorganSubmission

Thanks for the process — looking forward to the debrief.

Best,
Morgan

Attachments: morgan_taylor_takehome.zip (1 file, ~7MB)

- Option A: Wed 2026-10-14 11:00–11:45 PT (quick debrief)
- Option B: Thu 2026-10-15 14:00–14:45 PT
- Option C: Fri 2026-10-16 09:00–09:45 PT
